verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — Iran Expands Strikes to Kuwait + Bahrain; Hormuz Back to Pre-MoU Pace; GOOGL July 22 Is the Last Clearing Gate Before Capitulation
verdict.headline: Iran strikes Kuwait and Bahrain as Gulf conflict widens ahead of pivotal earnings week
verdict.rationale_short: Sunday July 19 brought the sharpest escalation of the Hormuz crisis yet: Iran fired drones and missiles at Kuwait and Bahrain, striking Kuwait's power and water desalination plant for the second consecutive day and targeting US military positions at Camp al-Adiri and Ali Al Salem airbase. Iran claimed to have stopped two ships in the Strait. The ceasefire framework is effectively collapsed; Hormuz transit is back to or below pre-MoU pace (~7 vessels/day). US markets are closed but Sunday's new theater of attack — GCC allies hit directly — will price into Monday's futures open. Last equity print: SPX 7,457.69 (below 7,460 formal trigger), Nasdaq 25,520.24, VIX 18.77, Brent $88.09, WTI $82.47. Seven of eight framework triggers are now active; only BTC Gate 2 ($62,000) is holding — live at $64,823 (+0.07%) at ~9pm ET, $2,823 cushion, fourth consecutive session of decoupling from the equity selloff. The week ahead carries three binary clearing events: (1) PYPL board response Monday to the $60.50/sh Stripe/Advent bid it views as inadequate; (2) GOOGL Q2 July 22 AMC — the single most critical AI-monetization read, now complicated by unconfirmed industry chatter about a Gemini 3.5 Pro postponement; (3) AMD AI Day July 22-23. STEP ASIDE is the correct posture; conviction elevated to high given Sunday's geographic expansion of Iranian strikes. Monday oil futures open is the first hard read on Kuwait/Bahrain escalation.

bear_case: Counter-thesis for upgrading to HOLD/BUY — five conditions could reverse the framework. (1) MONDAY CAPITULATION FLUSH — The Kuwait/Bahrain escalation was not priced into Friday's SPX 7,457.69. A sharp Monday open gap-down (SPX –2%+ open) could produce the volume capitulation that historically precedes a durable low — watch for high-volume intraday reversal as a long signal, not additional selling. (2) GOOGL JULY 22 FULL RESET — The strongest single counter-catalyst: Google Cloud +63% Q1 trend confirmed in Q2 with AI Overviews monetization explicitly quantified directly refutes the AI-fatigue thesis. A beat and strong Q3 guidance restores HOLD for the full framework regardless of Hormuz status. (3) CEASEFIRE BREAKTHROUGH — Any credible Iran-US framework that reopens Hormuz to 70%+ pre-blockade volume collapses Brent 5-10% and catalyzes 3-5% equity relief; the asymmetry is large given current risk premium. (4) BTC AS LEADING INDICATOR — BTC decoupling from equity selloff for four consecutive sessions in extreme-fear tape is the same pre-reversal signal seen in the April 2025 Liberation Day flush and January 2026 DeepSeek shock. If BTC clears $65K convincingly on Monday it is a green light for risk appetite ahead of GOOGL. (5) PYPL POSITIVE BINARY — A PYPL board decision to engage Stripe/Advent Monday morning is a $53B M&A premium event that provides a one-day positive risk-appetite catalyst independent of macro. Conditions to upgrade STEP ASIDE → HOLD: SPX two consecutive closes above 7,480 AND Brent below $83 AND VIX below 17. Any two of three on Monday = consider upgrading to HOLD/SELECTIVE.
